title: Bhagwan Vishnu kyun sote hain 4 mahine?
hooks: Devuthani Ekadashi par Bhagwan Vishnu jaag gaye hain.
Kya aapko pata hai shubh kaam aaj se hi kyun shuru hote hain?
Chaar mahine ki Yoga Nidra ke baad, aaj srishti jaag rahi hai.
hook_why: Uses the specific current date and a high-stakes claim about a deity awakening to trigger immediate curiosity as per the 2026 top-performer rules.
metaphor: The transition from a silent, dark cosmic ocean to a radiant, golden awakening representing the return of auspicious energy.

cast.Vishnu: Lord Vishnu with a calm, divine face, blue skin, wearing yellow silk pitambara, an ornate golden crown, resting on the multi-headed serpent Sheshnag in the cosmic ocean.
cast.Lakshmi: Goddess Lakshmi in a rich maroon and gold saree, radiant face, sitting respectfully near Lord Vishnu's feet.

scenes.vo: Devuthani Ekadashi par Bhagwan Vishnu apni chaar mahine ki neend se jaag gaye hain.
scenes.prompt: A cinematic close-up of Lord Vishnu's closed eyes, soft golden light hitting his face, slowly his eyes open with a divine glow. Painterly cinematic Indian miniature-meets-epic style, warm gold and deep maroon.
scenes.title: VISHNU JI JAAG GAYE

tries.prompt: A cinematic close-up of the idol from image 1, Lord Vishnu, possessing radiant blue skin, a calm divine face, and an ornate, intricate golden crown. His eyes are initially closed, then slowly opening with a soft, divine golden glow emanating from within. The scene is captured in a painterly cinematic Indian miniature-meets-epic style, bathed in warm gold and deep maroon tones, with soft divine light highlighting his features, vertical 9:16 composition, generous calm space above and below.

scenes.vo: Isse kehte hain Devuthani Ekadashi. Is din se hi saare ruki hui shadiyan aur shubh kaam phir shuru hote hain.
scenes.prompt: A traditional Indian wedding mandap being decorated with marigold flowers and bells, warm golden hour light, no people, focus on the ornate pillars. Ornate but uncluttered.
scenes.title: SHUBH KAAM SHURU

tries.prompt: A wedding mandap featuring ornate wooden pillars carved with intricate traditional patterns, decorated with vibrant marigold flower garlands and hanging brass bells. Vertical 9:16 composition, focusing on the pillars in the middle third.

scenes.vo: Ye chaar mahine yaani Chaturmas, bhakt ke liye sanyam aur dhyan ka samay hota hai.

figures.name: Vishnu
figures.look: Lord Vishnu possesses radiant blue skin, a calm divine face, and four arms holding a conch, chakra, mace, and lotus. He wears vibrant yellow silk pitambara garments and an ornate, intricate golden crown, radiating soft divine light.

figures.name: Lakshmi
figures.look: Goddess Lakshmi displays a serene face, draped in a luxurious red silk saree with gold embroidery. She sits upon a lotus, gold coins flowing from her hand, while majestic elephants stand beside her, adorned in ornate gold jewelry.

figures.name: Sage
figures.look: An elderly sage with a lean build, long white beard, and flowing hair sits in a meditative posture. He wears a simple saffron-colored cotton dhoti, maintaining a serene expression while seated cross-legged under a sprawling banyan tree.

figures.name: Sheshnag
figures.look: A massive multi-headed serpent with iridescent scales, coiled in a protective posture. Its eyes glow softly amidst the deep blue cosmic ocean, providing a divine base for Lord Vishnu, surrounded by ripples reflecting golden light.

places.name: Kshira Sagara
places.look: A vast cosmic ocean of deep blue water, illuminated by soft divine light. The surface remains calm with gentle ripples, reflecting a golden glow while the massive Sheshnag emerges from the depths, creating a mystical and serene atmosphere.

places.name: Wedding Mandap
places.look: Ornate wooden pillars carved with traditional patterns, decorated with vibrant marigold flower garlands and hanging brass bells. The space is bathed in warm golden hour light, maintaining an uncluttered, sacred, and celebratory appearance on the stone floor.

places.name: Vrindavan
places.look: A decorated clay pot containing a lush green Tulsi plant, adorned with a delicate red silk dupatta and gold jewelry. A smooth black Shaligram stone rests beside it, illuminated by the soft, flickering glow of warm candle light.

places.name: Courtyard
places.look: A traditional stone courtyard featuring an intricate, colorful rangoli pattern on the floor. Rows of glowing clay diyas illuminate the space, creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere with a temple shikhara visible against the dark, soft-focus background.
